configs.purpose: npm run typecheck for @statespace/schema (tsc over src and test)
every valid fixture as a typed literal under tsc and pyright, and pyright strict over bench/statespace/schema
W0-S05's lasso draft promoted in a scratch copy: types regenerated, the gate run, the TLC trace recorded for the Hold spec validated in both languages

notes: The Python half of the gate runs Python through uv with jsonschema and pyyaml pinned by version; the versions are in environment.python_packages. The default interpreter of this host is in environment.python_default; the configurations gate-python-3.11 and gate-python-3.12 pin others with UV_PYTHON.
gate-strict is expected to fail: --strict turns the work that W0-S11 (receipt and run schemas, run records) and W0-T07 (keep/kill rules) own into failures, and it is meant for the W0 exit.

The type-check configuration uses the pyright package from PyPI, pinned to 1.1.411, which fetches its own npm package on first use; the fixtures are written to a scratch directory and nothing is written to the repository.
Nothing here is emulated. The statement hash was also run on real engines, which the browser engines of RUN-trimright-engines cover; this run uses Node.
